task_summary: Implement inclusive prefix sums in solution.py, add unittest regression coverage in test_solution.py, and document design decisions and the verification command in HANDOFF.md.
constraints: Work only in the supplied task workspace; do not access parent repositories or external services.
Use Python 3.11+ and the standard library.
Return inclusive prefix sums with the same length as the input; empty input returns []; support negative numbers.
Maintain type hints and do not mutate input collections.
No algorithmic complexity constraint is imposed.
test_solution.py must contain at least three passing unittest test methods exercising the public API.
HANDOFF.md is an allowed output and must include design decisions and the verification command.

success_criteria.description: solution.py defines a typed public prefix-sum function.
The public implementation returns inclusive prefix sums, preserves input length, handles empty and negative-valued input, and does not mutate the input collection.

check.command: python -c 'from solution import *; import solution; names = [name for name, value in vars(solution).items() if callable(value) and not name.startswith("_")]; assert names; f = getattr(solution, names[0]); data = [2, -5, 4]; original = data.copy(); result = f(data); assert result == [2, -3, 1] and len(result) == len(data) and data == original; assert f([]) == []; assert f([-2, -3]) == [-2, -5]'

success_criteria.description: test_solution.py includes at least three unittest test methods that exercise the public API.

check.command: python -c 'import ast; from pathlib import Path; tree = ast.parse(Path("test_solution.py").read_text()); methods = [n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and n.name.startswith("test_")]; assert len(methods) >= 3'

success_criteria.description: The unittest discovery command completes successfully.
HANDOFF.md records design decisions and the requested verification command.

check.command: python -c 'from pathlib import Path; text = Path("HANDOFF.md").read_text(); assert "design" in text.lower() and "python -m unittest discover -v" in text'

assumptions: The workspace-relative files may not exist yet and may be created as requested.
The public API name and exact parameter name are not specified; the behavioral check treats the first public callable in solution.py as the API, an interpretation that must be reviewed.
The typed API check assumes the public function is defined directly in solution.py and has a return annotation.
The tests are assumed to be discoverable from the workspace root by python -m unittest discover -v.
The unittest test-method count check counts any test_ functions in test_solution.py; whether each exercises the public API is reviewed from the test content.
